name: MyPlugin
description: Fab-aware DRC (Lion Circuits), V/A net sizing, power pours + stitching, H/V autoroute, silkscreen cleanup, Eagle 3D models & symbols.
description_full:
One toolbar button opens a hub with eight tools:

- Fab Rules: sets Board Setup constraints and DRC to Lion Circuits capabilities (MII / Custom / Rush, 1-3 oz) and can make them the default for new projects.
- Net Setup: enter voltage and current per net; it computes IPC-2221 trace width, clearance and via size/count, creates netclasses, adds the sizes to the toolbar dropdowns and writes DRC rules that enforce them.
- Power Trace: size the selected net from V/A, widen its traces, route with the right width.
- Power Pours: copper around regulator pad groups, GND pours, plane vias for pads a pour would cut off, GND stitching vias.
- Autoroute H/V: Freerouting with horizontal top / vertical bottom layer preference; never shrinks traces below the netclass width.
- Silk Beautify: clean reference placement, net names on connector pins, values to Fab.
- 3D Models: gives footprints without a model (e.g. Eagle imports) the matching KiCad library 3D model, aligned by pad geometry.
- Eagle -> KiCad Symbols: swaps imported Eagle schematic symbols for KiCad library symbols, refusing to save if the netlist changes.

Autoroute needs Java 21+ and freerouting.jar (see README).
